title: studio: refusal text written for developers (class names, tracker ids, raw Zod paths, spec docstrings) is shown verbatim to authors
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio Data pillar: switching a field's type to Picklist shows the red banner quoted below to the author, verbatim.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

Text written for developers reaches low-code authors unchanged:
- "MetadataClient.save refused this object metadata write: the field `status` is a `select` with no options … or a shared `picklist` (objectstack#20827), so this draft stays here until it has one."
- "…`@objectstack/spec` refuses the same document at the server with a 422 on `fields.technician.reference` … (objectui#7714)."
- Raw Zod paths as banners: "nodes.2.config.title — …", "navigation.1.objectName — Invalid input …".
- Spec `.describe()` docstrings rendered as form help (the notify node's Template help ends "(maintainer ruling 2026-09-01). A producer-set payload.locale is not consulted."); the action Description help ends "(one dialog, not two —)" with a dangling dash.

## Where it comes from (read in source)

`assertObjectMetadataWritable` in `data-objectstack/src/object-metadata-write-guard.ts` builds the first two messages (class name, tracker ids, wire paths); `formatMetadataError` passes server issue paths through; inspectors render spec descriptions as help. The spec-side strings are objectstack-ai/objectstack#22093.

## Expected

An author-facing sentence attached to the input it is about, with the technical detail (path, code, ids) behind a disclosure.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Split every refusal into `{authorMessage, fieldPath, detail}`; map Zod paths to the inspector field; keep tracker ids out of runtime strings (the rule objectstack's AGENTS.md already applies to its own runtime prose).

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *developer facing error message MetadataClient.save refused tracker id zod path author*: 1 hits (0 open, 1 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *studio save error banner shows raw internal message issue number class name to author*: 2 hits (1 open, 1 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectstack (open and closed), *metadata save refusal message names internal class and zod path shown to Studio author*: 0 hits (0 open, 0 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectstack#21096 (closed) — same 'no tracker ids in author-visible text' rule (AGENTS.md), different surface (CLI lint)
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: developer facing error author · MetadataClient.save refused banner · raw zod path banner · describe docstring as help text
